newsitem.title: UK: Ramco signs Georgian production sharing deal.
newsitem.headline: Ramco signs Georgian production sharing deal.

text.p: British junior oil and gas company Ramco Energy Plc on Monday announced it signed a production sharing agreement with Georgia for an oil and gas field in the country's north east.

The contract, signed with state oil company Saknavtobi and the Ministry of Fuel and Energy, provides for full recovery of costs and the allocation of profits, Ramco said without being The company expects to be allowed to start shortly with seismic shooting on the block in the Alazani Valley and foothills of the Greater Caucasus Mountains.
The production sharing agreement follows the signing of a letter of intent in December.
